#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

string process(const string& s, size_t pos, bool& at_used) {
    if (pos >= s.size()) return "";
    if (pos + 2 < s.size() && s[pos] == 'd' && s[pos+1] == 'o' && s[pos+2] == 't') {
        string rest = process(s, pos+3, at_used);
        if (rest.empty()) return "dot";
        return "." + rest;
    } else if (pos + 1 < s.size() && s[pos] == 'a' && s[pos+1] == 't' && !at_used) {
        at_used = true;
        return "@" + process(s, pos+2, at_used);
    } else {
        return s[pos] + process(s, pos+1, at_used);
    }
}

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    bool at_used = false;
    string ans = process(s, 0, at_used);
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
